ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Near-zero macro-level ratio; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with negligible high-intensity white pixel coverage limited to distal tips and sparse micro-spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous, low-intensity black region. Sparse, high-contrast white pixels (1-3 pixel diameter) are non-contiguously distributed across the central and leading-edge areas without forming macro-geometric patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 90-degree V-shaped central depression; vertex is well-defined with a depth occupying approximately 12% of the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration frequency; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude pixel variations (jagged peaks) compared to the relatively smoother, lower-frequency variations on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the median notch, transitioning to a slight concavity at the lateral distal terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; secondary micro-clusters are detectable along the lower leading-edge perimeter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast white scarring or colonization marks at the terminal distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.
